results.excerpt: Rate limit incident Q3 2024: API consumers were not warned 24 hours before the rate limit threshold was lowered from 1000 to 500 requests per minute. Several clients experienced outages lasting 2-4 hours.
Lessons learned: (1) All limit changes require 72-hour advance notice. (2) Clients must have a documented escalation path. (3) Rate limit headers should be included in all API responses.

output_document.summary: Located incident documentation from Q3 2024 showing that an unannounced API rate limit reduction (1000 to 500 requests/minute) caused 2-4 hour outages for multiple clients. The postmortem lessons critical for the webhooks plan are: implement 72-hour advance notice for all API changes, establish documented client escalation paths, and expose rate limit information via HTTP headers. These safeguards must be built into the webhooks feature design to prevent repeating this incident.
